summary: Kerb on a busy road beside a bowls club, where cars park.
reasons: Bowls club greens on the west side
Homes 16-23 m away across the road

drivers.seclusion: Bowls club and fence behind the kerb; houses sit 16-23 m away across a wide road.
drivers.access_and_room: Vehicles are parked at this kerb in both images, so a van can stop, but the footpath and fence leave no pull-off beyond the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with a signalised junction and pedestrian crossing at the south end.
drivers.convention: Cars park here but there are no signs or marked parking lane, so it reads as a plain kerb on a busy road.

flags: Noise from busy road and junction
Pedestrian crossing just south of the section
Mapped gates 18 m and 39 m away do not block the only access
sun_shade: Open to the east morning sun; trees along the footpath give some shade.

best_section.where: West kerb of Clarence Road, beside the bowls club, north of the crossing
